name: Solvera
units: meters; x east, y south (game z)
notes: v3 (WORLD_V3_PLAN.md): four cities. v2 data was shifted by (+2000, +3000), so Bellerive's local coordinates are unchanged. Phase = build order.

factions.name: Aurum Consortium
factions.note: Corporate empire building the Solvera Line; philanthropic face, criminal muscle

factions.name: Halberd Security
factions.note: Private military firm; guards Aurum and the state, runs the docks at Headlands

factions.name: The Ledger
factions.note: Lobbyists, bankers and fixers who launder for everyone

factions.name: Castellane Family
factions.note: Old-school family of dons; restaurants, the docks union, protection

factions.name: High Water
factions.note: Crew from the storm-wrecked wards; part gang, part neighbourhood watch

factions.name: Comando Maré
factions.note: Porto Brisa's speedboat smugglers; in Bellerive they run the Keys and the swamp routes

factions.name: Os Corvos
factions.note: Porto Brisa's flashy club and beach crew; in Bellerive they hold a Brisa Beach club, Maré's rivals

factions.name: Velvet Aces
factions.note: Showbiz crime family skimming the Blaze's casinos

factions.name: Dust Riders
factions.note: Desert bikers running guns and meth along Route 40

factions.name: Tenmile Crew
factions.note: Heroin crew using teen runners in the emptied east side

factions.name: Copper Kings
factions.note: Scrappers and arsonists stripping dead plants and houses

factions.name: Assembly Workers Local 12
factions.note: The autoworkers' union, shrinking with the plants

factions.name: Dockers' Brotherhood
factions.note: Port workers in Ironwharf and Concordia; a strike can shut a harbour

factions.name: Hospitality Workers Local 7
factions.note: Casino and hotel workers; a walkout darkens the Blaze

factions.name: Skyward Fellowship
factions.note: Sky-watching self-help cult camped near Fort Granite; drains members' savings

factions.name: The Greenhold
factions.note: Back-to-the-land commune in the pines; hitchhikers go in and don't come out

factions.name: Police
factions.note: City PDs, Solvera State Police on highways, Capitol Guard in Concordia

factions.name: Solvera Defence Forces
factions.note: Fort Granite and the smaller bases; trespass brings a high wanted level

water.name: Lake Miravel
water.note: reservoir behind Granite Gorge Dam, shrinking

water.name: Morrow River
water.note: Lake Corran at Steelhaven down to the Gulf at Bellerive

water.name: Cinder River
water.note: below the dam, through Ember Canyon to the Saltgrass Glades

regions.name: Hollow Mesa County
regions.hook: Mesas, dry lakes, ghost towns, the Dust Riders and the Skyward camp

regions.name: Fort Granite Reservation
regions.hook: The state's biggest base: airfield, test range, the vault. Instant high wanted level

regions.name: Cinder County
regions.hook: The state's highest peaks, the pass road, silver mines and the Silver Train legend

regions.name: Miravel Shores
regions.hook: Cabins, water sports, the dam and the drowned village

regions.name: Red Pine County
regions.hook: Logging towns on the Morrow, the sawmill, the Greenhold commune

regions.name: Corran County
regions.hook: Lake country around Steelhaven: closed plants, a dying lake port, the Guard camp

regions.name: Sovereign County
regions.hook: Green hills and estates around the capital; the Headlands across the gate

regions.name: Verdant Hills
regions.hook: Vineyards and villas between Bellerive and the capital

regions.name: Bellerive Hills
regions.hook: Chaparral ridge north of the city: Crest Drive, the Canyon Freeway, the observatory and the hillside letters

regions.name: Golden Flats County
regions.hook: Wheat, crop dusters, truck stops, the Solvera Line's building sites

regions.name: Saltgrass Parish
regions.hook: The Saltgrass Glades: sawgrass swamp, airboats, smugglers' channels

regions.name: Serena Keys
regions.hook: The first of the Keys off Bellerive

regions.name: Isla Serena
regions.hook: Free-port resort island: smugglers and billionaires

cities.name: Bellerive
cities.inspired_by: Miami and New Orleans, with a DC civic centre, a Manhattan midtown and California suburbs
cities.theme: Gulf city: old French quarter, glass towers, storm-scarred wards, swamp, Deco beach, the Keys
cities.vibe: Humid, pastel, Latin and Creole, fast money, storm risk

npc_density.night: high in the Quarter and on the beach
npc_density.mix: tourists, club crowds, dockers, retirees, Spanish and Creole speakers

districts.name: Brisa Beach
districts.note: Pastel Deco hotels, Latin cafés, clubs on the Gulf

cities.name: Concordia
cities.inspired_by: Washington DC, New York and San Francisco
cities.theme: The planned state capital: radial avenues and circles, a monumental Mall, long Manhattan blocks, a bay with a red bridge, cable-car hills
cities.vibe: Monumental, orderly, watched; marble and green

npc_density.mix: office workers, tourists, school groups, guards, joggers, protesters

cities.name: Steelhaven
cities.theme: The motor city that emptied: gold Deco tower, glass HQs on the river, a vast dead plant, urban prairie, a reviving midtown
cities.vibe: Grit, rust, prairie silence, a comeback in a few streets

transit.note: The Loop is its metro: elevated, nearly empty; the central station is a ruin, trains stop at a platform beside it

npc_density.day: very low in the prairie, medium downtown
npc_density.mix: plant workers, scrappers, artists, students, the homeless, union men

cities.name: Las Brasas
cities.theme: Neon desert city: themed resorts on the Blaze, a canopied old town, gated suburbs, the dam and the range

transit.note: No tram: a car city; the monorail and the strip bus serve only the Blaze

npc_density.mix: tourists, gamblers, showgirls, card sharps, casino workers, bikers

towns.name: Bottle Flats
towns.note: Silver-boom town left in 1910; the bottle house still stands

towns.name: Dust Hollow
towns.note: Abandoned rail stop; Skyward Fellowship camp nearby

towns.name: Silverbell
towns.note: Mining ghost town on the pass road

towns.name: Port Ash
towns.note: Dying lake port; half the houses empty

routes.name: Headlands Road and Crimson Gate Bridge
Solvera Line (high-speed, being built)
routes.status: under construction; opening it is the story's spine

routes.name: Corran Commuter
routes.condition: two trains a day, often late

routes.name: Bay ferry (Ferry Building to the Headlands)
Devil's Staircase (4x4)
routes.condition: steep shelf road, the back way into Steelhaven

landmarks.name: Las Brasas Union (Solvera Line)
landmarks.condition: a shell until the Solvera Line opens

expansions.name: Porto Brisa
expansions.where: south, across the Gulf of Solvera (off this map)
expansions.theme: Beach city between green mountains and the sea: hillside favelas, Praia Dourada, a cable car, the old port
links: flights from Bellerive International and Sovereign International
the smugglers' speedboat route from the Keys
expansions.story: Jules's past as a getaway driver; Lua Ferreira; the Sentinel's Light; the Maré and Corvos war at home
